test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Choose the most suitable one-word substitution for the following.

A person who behaves in an unconventional manner.
solution: The correct answer is: **Eccentric**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Eccentric"** refers to a person who behaves in a way that is unconventional or strange. (अजीब या असामान्य व्यवहार करने वाला व्यक्ति) • **Example:** The eccentric artist painted landscapes using only his feet. • An eccentric person often defies societal norms and is known for their unique or peculiar habits. (अलग या अनोखी आदतों के लिए जाना जाता है) Therefore, the correct answer is: **Eccentric**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Reticent** (मितभाषी): A person who is reserved or unwilling to communicate their thoughts and feelings. • **Example:** Despite her reticent nature, she managed to deliver a heartfelt speech. • **Egotist** (अहंकारी): A person who is excessively self-centered and talks too much about themselves. • **Example:** He is such an egotist that he always brings every conversation back to himself. • **Stickler** (सख्त अनुशासनप्रिय व्यक्ति): A person who insists on strict adherence to rules or standards. • **Example:** The teacher was a stickler for punctuality and never allowed late submissions. 1b0:T93b, The correct answer is: **Graphologist**.
